look_here_first: Introduced scarletfruit passionflower comparison (not confirmed native to your target counties). Look first for an actual RIPE FRUIT: usually smooth and vivid red in the documented P. lanuginosa concept, versus greenish/yellow-green fruit in the locally reviewed P. foetida concept. Then inspect finely divided bract cage, hairy leaf and stem, and often more sharply pointed/angular leaf lobes. Older P. foetida var. lanuginosa specimens require taxonomic reconciliation; don't identify it by flower color or a fruit photo alone.

lookalikes.differences: Contrast fruit surface/color and leaf-lobe shape against canonical P. foetida; do not identify only from pink flowers or a single photograph. Use a full flower/fruit-bract view and mature fruit close-up.
